name: Analyze AI Content Marketing Audit
description: AI-powered content marketing audit analyzing usability, knowledge level, actionability, accuracy, business value, messaging, and brand voice fit.
project_description:
This module is part of the AI module ecosystem and included in DXPR CMS .

 Back to top 

 Find Out Why Some Content Converts and Some Doesn't 
 You published 200 blog posts. Some drive signups, most don't, and nobody knows why. This module scores every piece of content against seven proven marketing factors - usability, actionability, business value, and more - so you stop guessing and start optimizing.

 
 You need AI Content Marketing Audit if 
 
 Your content performs inconsistently and you can't pinpoint what separates winners from duds 
 You have a large content library that's never been systematically evaluated 
 Your marketing team makes content decisions based on gut feeling rather than measurable criteria 
 You want to benchmark new content against proven marketing principles before publishing 
 
 Back to top 

 What You Get 
 
 
 Seven marketing factors scored per page 
 Each content entity is evaluated on Usability, Knowledge Level, Actionability, Accuracy, Business Value, Messaging, and Brand Voice Fit - with scores from -1.0 (poor) to +1.0 (excellent).

 
 
 Quantitative and qualitative analysis 
 Numeric scoring for measurable factors plus categorical classification for subjective ones - giving you both the numbers and the narrative.

 
 
 Fully customizable factors 
 Add your own marketing factors, remove ones that don't apply, reorder by priority, and define custom options for qualitative dimensions.

 
 
 Batch analysis for content audits 
 Score your entire content library to identify low-performing content that needs rewriting, high performers worth promoting, and patterns across content types.

 
 
 AI Coding Assistant Integration 
 Marketing audit analysis is available to AI coding

 assistants through the Analyze module's built-in

 Agent

 Skills file. Run

 drush analyze:setup-ai to enable, then ask

 naturally:

 
 "Audit content marketing quality on all

 articles" 
 "Check the usability score for landing

 pages" 
 "Run a marketing audit on all published

 content" 
 
 Compatible with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI,

 GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other tools supporting the

 standard.

 
 
 Back to top 

 Getting Started 
 
 Set up an AI provider at /admin/config/ai/providers 
 Review and customize audit factors at /admin/config/analyze/content-marketing-audit 
 Enable the analyzer per content type at /admin/config/content/analyze-settings 
 Open any content entity's Analyze tab to see the scores 
 
 
 Prefer a turnkey demo site? 
 Spin up DXPR CMS - Drupal pre-configured with DXPR Builder, DXPR Theme, the full Analyze suite including AI Marketing Audit, and security best practices out of the box.

 Get DXPR CMS » 

 
 Additional requirements 
 
 This module requires:

 
 Analyze module (>=1.1.0) 
 AI module with a configured chat provider 
 Views Color Scales module 
 

 Related Modules 
 
 Analyze - Required. Provides the plugin framework and Analyze tab this module extends 
 AI - Required. Supplies the LLM provider used for scoring content against marketing factors 
 Views Color Scales - Required. Renders color-coded score columns in the marketing audit Views report 
 AI Content Security Audit - Sibling Analyze plugin that detects PII and credential leaks 
 AI Sentiments Analysis - Sibling Analyze plugin that measures tone, trust, and reading level 
 Analyze Broken Links - Sibling Analyze plugin that checks link health without AI 
 
 AI Content Marketing Audit is part of the Analyze suite included in DXPR CMS , a turnkey marketing CMS for Drupal that combines content analysis, a premium Drupal theme , and a drag-and-drop layout builder . See getting started or explore pricing .
